places.description: A rented row-house unit in an inland rail-and-manufacturing city where residential streets sit near workshops, warehouses and older industrial corridors.
A comprehensive public school with academic classrooms, practical workshops, sports facilities, music rooms and access to vocational guidance.
A tram and regional-rail stop used by students and shift workers, with posted service rules, transfers and occasional disruptions.
A commercial street of repair shops, bakeries, second-hand stores, small manufacturers and household services.
A municipal cultural and adult-education center with a library branch, evening courses, exhibitions, public meetings and low-cost events.

householdShape: Two caregivers, the subject and one older sibling share a rented home; one caregiver works regular hours while the other has rotating shifts.
familyRelations: The older sibling is three years older than the subject.
Extended family members live in another part of the city and are seen several times a year.
materialCircumstances: Basic needs are stable but household choices are budget-conscious; work schedules, rent, transit costs and repair of durable goods shape ordinary planning.
mobilityPattern: Daily travel mixes walking, tram and regional rail; school and family routines occasionally cross industrial, residential and civic districts.
schoolingOrCommunityContext: School offers both academic and practical routes without requiring an early specialization; municipal courses, clubs, libraries and workplaces are visible but unevenly accessible.
culturalContext: The city contains families tied to manufacturing and services, students, newer migrants, civic associations, trade organizations, faith communities and secular institutions; public norms and workplace practices are not always identical.
intellectualEnvironment: Classroom subjects, practical demonstrations, local newspapers, technical manuals, library books, music and exhibitions, workplace stories, public meetings and ordinary arguments provide varied access to ideas without prescribing which ones matter.
